goals.title: Bounded C/Python to Omega lifter
goals.description: Lift toc-generated C/Python and a human C/Python scalar subset back to .om; prove round trip and differential behaviour on Spark and Mac.

milestones.description: Lifter source in seeded Omega, convertible by toc
Round-trip byte identity on >=12 toc units (C and Python)
Human C/Python fixtures differential-tested (>=200 vectors each)
Refusal paths pinned; mutation negative control
Mac self-conversion byte identity (clang C and python3)
